scope.frame: no frame: the fibre's character variety, symbolic, and over F_p for every prime p <= 47
scope.object: which moves conserve kappa, the non-invertible strata's kappa-laws, kappa as tr[a, b], and the number of readings on every leaf

claim_one_line: LISTENING 7, WHAT CHANGES KAPPA (PROVED, exact; data-free): every move of the grammar, and the open swap and sign, conserves kappa = tr[a, b], the records' frustrated remainder; only the non-invertible strata change it (by (kappa - 2) M), outside the grammar; so each frustration level is a sector of the whole; the law's counting gives every leaf about p^2 readings: 'nothing' exactly p^2 + 1, the cusp exactly p^2 + 3(-1/p)p + 1 (the one level whose correction is three), the others p^2 + {-(4p-1), -(2p-1), 2p+1, 4p+1}; no level is preferred
weave_or_thread: weave (every move, every leaf, nothing chosen)
